title: Flamingo with sparkly eyes
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- legs -->
  <line x1="48" y1="72" x2="44" y2="92" stroke="#FF8FA3" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="56" y1="72" x2="60" y2="92" stroke="#FF8FA3" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <path d="M38 92 Q44 92 45 92" stroke="#FFB3C1" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none"/>
  <path d="M54 92 Q60 92 64 92" stroke="#FFB3C1" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none"/>
  
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx="52" cy="58" rx="22" ry="16" fill="#FF6B8A"/>
  <ellipse cx="52" cy="58" rx="22" ry="16" fill="#FF85A0" opacity="0.5"/>
  
  <!-- tail feathers -->
  <path d="M30 55 Q22 48 26 42 Q30 46 34 50" fill="#FF4D6D"/>
  <path d="M28 60 Q18 55 20 48 Q26 52 32 56" fill="#FF6B8A"/>
  
  <!-- neck -->
  <path d="M62 50 Q72 38 68 24 Q66 16 70 12" stroke="#FF6B8A" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none"/>
  <path d="M62 50 Q72 38 68 24 Q66 16 70 12" stroke="#FF85A0" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none" opacity="0.5"/>
  
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx="72" cy="12" r="10" fill="#FF6B8A"/>
  <circle cx="72" cy="12" r="10" fill="#FF85A0" opacity="0.4"/>
  
  <!-- beak -->
  <path d="M80 10 Q90 12 88 16 Q84 18 80 15" fill="#FFB3C1"/>
  <path d="M80 10 Q86 11 87 14" fill="#FF8FA3"/>
  <circle cx="87" cy="14" r="1.5" fill="#2B1B3D"/>
  
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx="70" cy="10" r="3" fill="#2B1B3D"/>
  <circle cx="67" cy="9" r="2.5" fill="#2B1B3D"/>
  
  <!-- sparkle in eyes -->
  <circle cx="70.5" cy="9.5" r="1.2" fill="#E0F7FF"/>
  <circle cx="69" cy="11" r="0.6" fill="#E0F7FF"/>
  <circle cx="67.5" cy="8.5" r="1" fill="#E0F7FF"/>
  <circle cx="66.5" cy="9.5" r="0.5" fill="#E0F7FF"/>
  
  <!-- eye sparkle stars -->
  <path d="M71 7.5 l0.4 -1 l0.4 1" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="0.5" fill="none"/>
  <path d="M69.5 12.5 l0.3 -0.8 l0.3 0.8" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="0.5" fill="none"/>
  <path d="M67 11.5 l0.3 -0.7 l0.3 0.7" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="0.5" fill="none"/>
  
  <!-- wing -->
  <path d="M42 52 Q50 46 58 50 Q52 56 44 56 Z" fill="#FF4D6D"/>
  <path d="M44 53 Q50 49 54 51" stroke="#FF85A0" stroke-width="1" fill="none"/>
  
  <!-- body highlight -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="55" rx="10" ry="5" fill="#FF9DB5" opacity="0.6"/>
</svg>
